page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a single thread per core configuration, the instance provides predictable compute performance. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation and high resource density of the ecs.g7.32xlarge make it a viable option for enterprise workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of multi-threading.

The balanced compute-to-memory ratio and high core count make this instance suitable for large-scale enterprise applications, web serving clusters, medium-sized databases, container orchestration nodes, and continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.
